# Overview

This is data from a gastric clones derived from biopsies in IM/non-IM sites which were analyzed by RNASeq 
For analysis, a preranked analysis using the R package fGSEA is used that should give similar results to preranked analysis in standard GSEA. 

# MSigDB gene sets

Since MSigDB gene sets use human gene symbols to map genes to pathways we will translate mouse symbols to homologous human symbols using HomologeneDB from NCBI (build 68). 

```{r}
load(file.path(result_folder, "DGE_analysis_image.Rdata"))
```

```{r}
gsea_gmt_folder = "../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/MSigDB/msigdb_v2023.2.Hs_GMTs/"
gsea_gmt_files = c("h.all.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt","c2.all.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt","c3.all.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt","c5.go.bp.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt","c6.all.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt","c7.all.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt")

names(gsea_gmt_files) = c("HALLMARK","PATHWAYS","MOTIF","GO_BP","ONCOGENIC","IMMUNOLOGIC")
gset_collections_human = list()
for (n in names(gsea_gmt_files)) {
  gset_collections_human[[n]] = gmtPathways(paste(gsea_gmt_folder, gsea_gmt_files[[n]], sep="/") )
}
```

# Other gene sets

The following additional gene sets are used:

- Munoz et al Small Intestinal Stem Cell Signature (PMID: 22692129, DOI: 10.1038/emboj.2012.166, Supp Table S3 )
- Mallon et al StemCellDB (PMID: 23117585)
- Herbst et al Beta-catenine target genes (PMID: 24467841)
- Palmer et al 'Pluripotency' Signature (PMID: 22909066, DOI: doi: 10.1186/gb-2012-13-8-r71). The modules defined by Palmer et al are as follows
      - 1 - DNA replication / cell cycle module
      - 2 - RNA transcription / protein synthesis module
      - 3 - metabolism / hormone signaling / protein synthesis module
      - 4 - multicellular signaling / immune signaling / cell identity module
- Colon vs. Stomach signature (generated by using data from colon biobank normal tissues [van Wetering et al., PMID: 25957691] and gastric glands [Bartfeld et al ,PMID: 25307862]; see /data/public_data/GSE64392_colon_biobank/ for details )
- IM vs healthy signature (strongly up- or downregulated genes in complete and incomplete IM vs healthy control using GE data published by Companioni O 2017 PlosOne [doi: 10.1371/journal.pone.0176043]; see /data_genome2/public_data/GSE78523_IM_GC for details)
- Gut tissue specific gene sets derived from Protein Atlas (proteinatlas.org) tissue specific gene lists. Those consist of tissue enriched (>5 fold higher mRNA compared to all other tissues), group enriched (>5 fold higher mRNA in 2-7 tissues compared to rest) and tissue enhanced (>5 fold higher mRNA to average in rest). We only include *tissue enriched* and *group enriched* genes.


```{r}
# Missing GS: - Barker et al Antral Stem Cell Signature (PMID: 20085740, DOI: 10.1016/j.stem.2009.11.013 ) MOUSE
known_genes = unique(all_results[[1]]$GeneSymbol)

intestinal_sc_sets = gmtPathways("../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/LGR5_StemCellSignature/SC_and_CryptCell_Signatures_human.gmt" )
all_gene_sets = list()
all_gene_sets[["Lgr5_SC_Signature_Munoz"]] = intestinal_sc_sets[["Lgr5_SC_Signature_Munoz"]]

beta_cat_genes = as.data.frame(read_excel("../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/LGR5_StemCellSignature/Wnt target H2014 list.xls", sheet = 1, col_names=FALSE), stringsAsFactors=F)
all_gene_sets[["Herbst_et_al_Beta_catenin_targets"]] = beta_cat_genes$...1


# Palmer SC signature
palmer_sc_sig = read.table("../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/StemCell_Signature_Palmer_et_al_2012.txt", sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)

for (i in c(1:4)) {
  all_gene_sets[[paste("Palmer_SC_signature_Module_",i)]] = unique(subset(palmer_sc_sig, Modul==i)$GeneSymbol)
}

# StemCellDB (Mallon et al)
mallon_sc_sig = read.table("../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/Pluripotency Signature Mallon StemCellDB.csv", sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)
all_gene_sets[["StemCellDB_signature_Mallon"]] = unique(mallon_sc_sig$Gene)

# Colon vs. Stomach signature
colon_sig_tmp = read.table("../../../../Data/ExtData/Colon_vs_Stomach/Colon_vs_Stomach_DGE.txt", sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F) 
all_gene_sets[["Colon_vs_Stomach"]] = subset(colon_sig_tmp, logFC > 1 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)$SYMBOL

tmp = read.table("../../../../Data/ExtData/Companioni_IM/IM_signature_genes_Companioni.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
all_gene_sets[["IM_vs_healthy_Companioni"]] = as.character(tmp$gene)

tmp = read.table("../../../../Data/ExtData/Companioni_IM/Healthy_vs_IM_signature_genes_Companioni.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
all_gene_sets[["Healthy_vs_IM_Companioni"]] = as.character(tmp$gene)

tissues = c("colon","duodenum","esophagus","liver","pancreas","small","stomach")
for (tt in tissues) {
  ifile = paste("../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/ProteinAtlas/Tissue_specific_genes/tissue_specificity_rna_",tt,"_.tsv.gz", sep="")
  tmp = read.table(gzfile(ifile), sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F, quote='', comment.char="")
  all_gene_sets[[paste("Tissue_specific_genes_",tt, sep="")]] = subset(tmp, RNA.tissue.category %in% c("Tissue enriched","Group enriched"))$Gene
}

gset_collections_human[["CUSTOM"]] = all_gene_sets

gset_collections_mouse = list()
```


## fGSEA analysis 

```{r, eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
homologene_human_mouse = fread("../../../../Data/ExtData/HomologousGenes/HomoloGene/build68/homologene_9606_10090.txt")
all_entrez_ids = data.frame(EntrezID=unique(all_results[[1]]$EntrezID))
all_symbols = data.frame(GeneSymbol=unique(all_results[[1]]$GeneSymbol))
a1 = merge(all_symbols, homologene_human_mouse[,c("entrez_1","symbol_1","symbol_2"), with=F], by.x="GeneSymbol", by.y="symbol_1", all.x=T, sort=F)

mouse_to_human=a1
mouse_to_human = subset(mouse_to_human, !is.na(GeneSymbol) & !is.na(symbol_2) & !symbol_2 == "" & !GeneSymbol=="")
rownames(mouse_to_human) = mouse_to_human$GeneSymbol
```


### Human and Mouse gene sets

For analyzing the human MsigDB gene sets we restrict the DGE data to those probesets that have a homologous gene in mouse and human. For those probesets we select the one with the highest t-score and rank the resulting list which is subsequently used for fGSEA analysis. 

<!-- For mouse gene sets (i.e. those derived from mouse experiments) we use the full set of genes in the DGE results after collapsing t-scores by gene and ranking.  -->

```{r}
data_generation_date = "2024-02-12"
output_folder = result_folder
GSEA_datafile = paste(output_folder,"fGSEA_Results.Rdata",sep="/")
if (!file.exists(output_folder)) dir.create(output_folder, recursive=T)

rerun_GSEA = TRUE

if(rerun_GSEA) {
  all_gsea_results = list()
  n_perm = 5000
  n_proc = 8
  bpparam = MulticoreParam(worker=n_proc, manager.hostname="127.0.0.1")
  for (n in names(all_results)) {
    print(paste("Running FGSEA for comparison",n))
    gsea_result_tables = list()
    tmp = subset(all_results[[n]], !is.na(GeneSymbol)) # those are mostly control probes
    
    # tmp2 = merge(tmp, mouse_to_human, by="GeneSymbol")
    # tmp2 = subset(tmp2, !is.na(symbol_1))
    ranks = unlist(tapply(tmp$log2FoldChange, tmp$GeneSymbol, function(x) x[which(abs(x)==max(abs(x)))] ))
  
    for (gs in names(gset_collections_human)) {
      print(gs)
      fgseaRes <- fgsea(gset_collections_human[[gs]], ranks, minSize=15, maxSize=2000, nperm=n_perm, BPPARAM=bpparam)
      fgseaRes$GeneSetCollection = gs
      gsea_result_tables[[gs]] = fgseaRes
    }
    
    results_human = do.call(rbind, gsea_result_tables)
    
    # gsea_result_tables_mouse = list()
    # ranks_mouse = unlist(tapply(tmp$t, tmp$GeneSymbol, function(x) x[which(abs(x)==max(abs(x)))] ))
    # 
    # for (gs in names(gset_collections_mouse)) {
    #   print(gs)
    #   fgseaRes <- fgsea(gset_collections_mouse[[gs]], ranks_mouse, minSize=15, maxSize=2000, nperm=n_perm, BPPARAM=bpparam)
    #   fgseaRes$GeneSetCollection = gs
    #   gsea_result_tables_mouse[[gs]] = fgseaRes
    # }
  
    # results_mouse = do.call(rbind, gsea_result_tables_mouse)
    # results_all = rbind(results_human, results_mouse)
    results_all = results_human
    results_all$FDR_global = p.adjust(results_all$pval, "BH")
    
    all_gsea_results[[n]] = results_all
  }
  save(all_gsea_results, file=GSEA_datafile)
  save(gset_collections_human, gset_collections_mouse, file=file.path(output_folder, "Geneset_collections.Rdata"))
} else {
  load(GSEA_datafile)
}
```

Result files are written to folder `r result_folder`

We export all gene sets with less than 10% FDR after global adjustment of p-values per sample. 

```{r}
FDR_threshold = 0.1
if(rerun_GSEA) {
  output_file_prefix = paste(result_folder,"fGSEA_Results_", sep="/")
  for (n in names(all_gsea_results)) {
    filename = paste(output_file_prefix, n, ".txt", sep="" )
    tmp = all_gsea_results[[n]]
    tmp$direction= ifelse(tmp$NES > 0, "Up","Down")
    tmp = tmp[order(tmp$NES, decreasing=T),]
    tmp$leadingEdge = unlist(lapply(tmp$leadingEdge, function(x) paste(x, collapse=",")))
    tmp = subset(tmp, FDR_global < FDR_threshold)
    col_order = c("pathway","GeneSetCollection","direction","pval","padj","ES","NES","nMoreExtreme","size","leadingEdge", "FDR_global")
    write.table(tmp[,col_order, with=F], file= filename, row.names=F , sep="\t", dec=".", quote=F, na="")
  }
  
  
  DGE_Excel_filename = paste(result_folder,"fGSEA_Results",sep="/")
  txt2xlsx_command = paste("python2 /data_genome1/SharedSoftware/inhouse_development/tools/txt2xlsx.py -o",DGE_Excel_filename," -L", paste(names(all_gsea_results),collapse=","),  paste(paste('"', output_file_prefix, names(all_gsea_results), '.txt"', sep="" ), collapse=" "), sep=" ")
  system(txt2xlsx_command)

}
```



```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
gsea_summary = list()
for (n in names(all_gsea_results)) {
  tmp = subset(all_gsea_results[[n]], padj < 0.05)
  r = as.data.frame(table(tmp$GeneSetCollection, ifelse(tmp$ES<0, "Down","Up")))
  colnames(r) = c("Collection","Direction","Freq")
  r$Comparison = n
  gsea_summary[[n]] = r
}

gsea_summary_df = do.call(rbind, gsea_summary)

ggplot(gsea_summary_df, aes(x=Comparison, y = Freq, fill=Collection)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + theme_grey(base_size = 14) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) + ggtitle("Number of significant (FDR<5%) gene sets per comparison")

ggplot(gsea_summary_df, aes(x=Comparison, y = Freq, fill=Collection)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + theme_grey(base_size = 14) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) + ggtitle("Number of significant (FDR<5%) gene sets per comparison") + facet_wrap(~Direction)
```
